lines.en: I shuffle through the swamp.
My steps are short and slow.
I go around the puddle.
I squeeze between roots.

lines.zh: 我走一步，身上的东西就晃
lines.en: Something on me wobbles with each step.
I put my snout to the ground.
I move about near my anchor.
I drag my feet through the leaves.
I shuffle into the light.

lines.zh: 我一步一步地跟在你后面
lines.en: I follow behind you, step by step.
I sit on the ground, not moving.
My eyes are half open.
It is damp here; that is comfortable.
I open my mouth and nothing comes out.
I lower my head slowly.
There is a smell about me.
I lie still and wait.
I am watching a bug crawl.
My claws draw circles.
I do not want to move at all.
The swamp water never stops.
I open my mouth and yawn.
I am hungry, but too lazy to look.
I curl myself up.

lines.zh: 你鞋底还沾着沼泽的泥。
lines.en: There is still swamp mud on your soles.

lines.zh: 我抬头望你，眼睛圆圆的
lines.en: I look up at you with round eyes.
I shuffle a little closer.
My mouth won't work; I can't explain.
Do not mind that I am dirty.
Are you my trainer?
I tilt my head and wait.
You are very clean.
I lick my lips.
I know your hands.
I sniff your boot.
I look up with round eyes.
Should we be going?

lines.zh: 我背上的绒毛被削掉一撮。
lines.en: A tuft of fuzz was shaved off my back.
I plop down on the ground.
That blow hurt.
A bit of me fell off.
I shrink back behind you.
I shake myself off.
My body is still against the ground.
I will remember this pain.
I have not got my breath back.
This beats what is in the swamp.
I gulp it down in one go.
I want more after eating.
This little bit will not do.
Do not take it away yet.
I get crumbs all over my face.
I can tell; it is good.
I sit at your feet and wait.
Do not pull your hand back.
You bumped right into me.

lines.zh: 我太矮，你的靴子擦过我耳朵。
lines.en: I'm so short your boot brushed past my ear.
Your foot came down on my claw.
I shuffle half a pace to the side.

lines.zh: 我这么矮，你差点没看见
lines.en: I am this low; you nearly missed me.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我坐倒了
lines.en: We collide and I plop down.
A little piece of me drops off.
I push up slowly on my legs.
Do not bump into me again.
I only think about eating.
I know nothing about such things.

lines.zh: 我在沼泽里找一个伴不容易
lines.en: A mate is hard to find in a swamp.
Do not ask about that again.
I drop my head.
I wag my tail twice.
I do not much care about that.
I plop myself down.
I pick it up and turn it over.
I ate the mud with it.
I push it with a claw.
Whose is this? I keep it.
It fell in the mud.
I bury it in the mud.
This has a smell.
I dig it up again.

lines.zh: 我的爪子先抓紧了地面。
lines.en: My claws dug into the ground first.
I push up onto my legs.
I plant myself across your front.
It cannot get out of my sight.
I lower my head slowly.
It is very close to us.
I am going to throw.
I am set on my side.
I move before it does.
It should not come this way.
I glare at it without blinking.
I hold the space between you.
I want you behind me.
I count each of its movements.
My tail has come up.
It backs off, and I shuffle forward.
I press myself even lower.
It has come into my ground.
My foreclaw is up.
This one will not fall short.
I am still ahead of you.
This is all I can do.
I fling it.
It strikes the target.
I pick up another.

lines.zh: 我横在你前面一步没退
lines.en: I stood in front of you and did not yield.
I am knocked onto my seat.
I prop up my front half.
It has drawn back a bit.
I am still panting hard.
This is what I can do.
Do not edge any further forward.
My anchor settled on this wet ground.
I lift my head slowly.
The smell here is strong.
I sit by a root.
My feet sink into the mud.
I saw you at once.
This place is very quiet.
I give a short call by way of greeting.
I chose this soft ground.
I will wait here for you.
Fire burns the mud on me.
I fall off the root.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水淹到我的头顶
lines.en: The swamp water closes over my head.
The blast throws me into the mud.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉进我背上的皮
lines.en: An arrow buries in the hide on my back.

lines.zh: 魔法把我的数据打散了
lines.en: Magic scatters my data.
I really am hungry now.

lines.zh: 雷打在沼泽上，我缩成一团
lines.en: Lightning strikes the swamp and I curl up.
The mud under me is gone.
